targets.query:
from(bucket: "rttf")
 |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "summary")
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "load_mw" or r._field == "gen_mw" or r._field == "sgen_mw" or r._field == "slack_mw" or r._field == "loss_mw")
 |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "rttf")
 |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "summary")
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "step" or r._field == "day" or r._field == "solve_ms" or r._field == "converged")
 |> last()
 |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "rttf")
 |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "line" and r._field == "loading_percent")
 |> keep(columns: ["_time", "id", "_value"])
 |> group(columns: ["id"])

from(bucket: "rttf")
 |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bus" and r._field == "vm_pu")
 |> keep(columns: ["_time", "name", "_value"])
 |> group(columns: ["name"])

from(bucket: "rttf")
 |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "summary")
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "loss_mw" or r._field == "max_loading_pct" or r._field == "min_vm_pu")
 |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
